attributionText: Wikibooks contributors, Cookbook:Tostones (Fried Plantains), revision 4480709. Adapted by HomeChef: ingredients, quantities, timings and instructions are clarified; optional variations are resolved in this preparation.
instructions: Peel and slice the plantain. Warm oil in a frying pan over medium-low heat. Fry the slices on both sides until tender and golden, turning carefully. Drain on a plate lined with paper towel and cool briefly. This follows the source's ripe-plantain preparation.
title: Tostones (Fried Plantains)

attributionText: Wikibooks contributors, Cookbook:Nigerian Boiled Plantain, revision 4480718. Adapted by HomeChef: ingredients, quantities, timings and instructions are clarified; optional variations are resolved in this preparation.
instructions: Peel and cut plantains into large pieces. Cover with water in a saucepan, bring to a boil and simmer until tender when pierced. Drain and serve as a side. The source's optional sauces are omitted.
title: Nigerian Boiled Plantain

attributionText: Wikibooks contributors, Cookbook:Scrambled Eggs with Vegetables, revision 4493922. Adapted by HomeChef: ingredients, quantities, timings and instructions are clarified; optional variations are resolved in this preparation.
instructions: Chop the tomatoes, cucumber and onion. Heat oil in a skillet and cook tomato and cucumber for 2 minutes. Beat eggs with onion and salt. Add to the pan and cook, folding frequently, until the eggs are completely set. Serve hot.
title: Scrambled Eggs with Vegetables

attributionText: Wikibooks contributors, Cookbook:Pasta with Vegetables, revision 4493953. Adapted by HomeChef: ingredients, quantities, timings and instructions are clarified; optional variations are resolved in this preparation.
instructions: Bring water and salt to a boil and add spaghetti. After 4 minutes add chopped tomato and cucumber. Continue until pasta is tender, following the packet time. Drain. Stir in finely chopped onion, olive oil and tomato pasta sauce, then warm through before serving.
title: Pasta with Vegetables

attributionText: Wikibooks contributors, Cookbook:Nigerian Tomato Omelette, revision 4493957. Adapted by HomeChef: ingredients, quantities, timings and instructions are clarified; optional variations are resolved in this preparation.
instructions: Dice tomatoes and cook in oil in a skillet until softened. Beat eggs with salt and pepper and mix with the tomatoes. Return to the pan over medium-low heat. When the underside sets, turn or fold carefully and continue until the egg is fully cooked.
title: Nigerian Tomato Omelette

attributionText: Wikibooks contributors, Cookbook:Yam and Egg Sauce, revision 4494028. Adapted by HomeChef: ingredients, quantities, timings and instructions are clarified; optional variations are resolved in this preparation.
instructions: Peel and slice the yam. Cover with water in a saucepan and boil until tender, then drain. Blend tomatoes and pepper to a paste. Beat the eggs and salt into the paste. Heat peanut oil in a skillet and cook the mixture, stirring, until eggs are fully set. Serve with the yam.
title: Yam and Egg Sauce

attributionText: Wikibooks contributors, Cookbook:Roasted Potatoes, revision 4494703. Adapted by HomeChef: ingredients, quantities, timings and instructions are clarified; optional variations are resolved in this preparation.
instructions: Heat oven to 200 C (400 F). Wash and dry similarly sized potatoes and pierce their skins with a fork. Place in an ovenproof pot or baking dish. Roast until tender all the way through when pierced, about 50-65 minutes depending on size.
title: Roasted Potatoes

attributionText: Wikibooks contributors, Cookbook:Fried Potatoes, revision 4494795. Adapted by HomeChef: ingredients, quantities, timings and instructions are clarified; optional variations are resolved in this preparation.
instructions: Peel and thinly slice the potatoes. Rinse, then dry thoroughly. Heat peanut oil in a skillet over medium heat. Fry potatoes in a single layer, working in batches and turning until golden and tender throughout. Season with salt.
title: Fried Potatoes

attributionText: Wikibooks contributors, Cookbook:Kid-Friendly Pasta, revision 4499839. Adapted by HomeChef: ingredients, quantities, timings and instructions are clarified; optional variations are resolved in this preparation.
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add spaghetti and thin carrot strips. After 4 minutes add trimmed green beans and cook until the pasta and vegetables are tender, following the pasta package time. Heat tomato sauce in a saucepan. Drain pasta and vegetables, toss with sauce and season.
title: Kid-Friendly Pasta

attributionText: Wikibooks contributors, Cookbook:Fried Eggs (Olive Oil-basted), revision 4500299. Adapted by HomeChef: ingredients, quantities, timings and instructions are clarified; optional variations are resolved in this preparation.
instructions: Warm olive oil in a small frying pan over medium-low heat. Crack in the egg. Carefully spoon hot oil over the top as the bottom cooks, lowering heat if it splutters. Continue until the white and yolk are firm. Lift out with a slotted spatula and season.
title: Fried Eggs (Olive Oil-basted)

attributionText: Wikibooks contributors, Cookbook:Scribbled Eggs, revision 4500566. Adapted by HomeChef: ingredients, quantities, timings and instructions are clarified; optional variations are resolved in this preparation.
instructions: Chop tomato and green onion. Heat the oil in a skillet. Cook tomato for a minute, then add the green onion and cook another minute. Beat the eggs and pour over the vegetables. Stir and fold over medium-low heat until the eggs are fully set. Serve hot.
title: Scribbled Eggs

attributionText: Wikibooks contributors, Cookbook:Egg Noodles II, revision 4501492. Adapted by HomeChef: ingredients, quantities, timings and instructions are clarified; optional variations are resolved in this preparation.
instructions: Beat yolks, whole egg, salt and pepper. Stir in 80 ml water and flour to form a firm dough. Knead until smooth. Roll on a floured surface to 2-4 mm thick and cut into narrow noodles. Bring a large pot of water to a boil, add oil and noodles, and cook until tender throughout. Drain and serve.
title: Egg Noodles II

attributionText: Wikibooks contributors, Cookbook:Mashed Potatoes, revision 4502781. Adapted by HomeChef: ingredients, quantities, timings and instructions are clarified; optional variations are resolved in this preparation.
instructions: Peel and cut potatoes into chunks. Cover with water and boil until tender. Drain well and mash while hot. Mix in butter and warm milk and serve immediately.
title: Mashed Potatoes

attributionText: Wikibooks contributors, Cookbook:Honey Garlic Chicken, revision 4505210. Adapted by HomeChef: ingredients, quantities, timings and instructions are clarified; optional variations are resolved in this preparation.
instructions: Cut chicken into bite-size pieces. Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add the chicken, honey and minced garlic. Cook, stirring and turning, until the chicken reaches 74 C (165 F) throughout. Reduce heat if the honey darkens too quickly, adding a spoonful of water if needed. Serve hot.
title: Honey Garlic Chicken

attributionText: Wikibooks contributors, Cookbook:Fried Pita Bread with Eggs, revision 4505735. Adapted by HomeChef: ingredients, quantities, timings and instructions are clarified; optional variations are resolved in this preparation.
instructions: Warm the olive oil in a skillet over medium-low heat. Tear the pita into small pieces and fry, stirring, until crisp. Beat the eggs and add them to the bread. Stir and fold until the eggs are fully set. Season and serve hot.
title: Fried Pita Bread with Eggs

attributionText: Wikibooks contributors, Cookbook:Roast Chicken on Salt, revision 4510625. Adapted by HomeChef: ingredients, quantities, timings and instructions are clarified; optional variations are resolved in this preparation.
instructions: Heat oven to 190 C (375 F). Place quartered lemon, garlic and rosemary in the chicken cavity. Spread salt in a roasting tray and place the chicken on it. Roast for about 90 minutes, until the thickest breast and thigh reach 74 C (165 F). Rest for 10 minutes and brush away excess salt before carving.
title: Roast Chicken on Salt

attributionText: Wikibooks contributors, Cookbook:Cucumber Bits in Yogurt, revision 4510867. Adapted by HomeChef: ingredients, quantities, timings and instructions are clarified; optional variations are resolved in this preparation.
instructions: Wash and dice the cucumber. Stir into plain yogurt and season with a little salt. Serve chilled.
title: Cucumber Bits in Yogurt

attributionText: Wikibooks contributors, Cookbook:Papaya Lassi, revision 4510879. Adapted by HomeChef: ingredients, quantities, timings and instructions are clarified; optional variations are resolved in this preparation.
instructions: Combine water, yogurt, honey, salt, papaya pulp and cinnamon in a blender. Blend until smooth. Pour into glasses and serve chilled.
title: Papaya Lassi

attributionText: Wikibooks contributors, Cookbook:Sweet Mango Lassi, revision 4511034. Adapted by HomeChef: ingredients, quantities, timings and instructions are clarified; optional variations are resolved in this preparation.
instructions: Stir sugar into mango nectar until dissolved. Gradually whisk chilled milk into yogurt. Stir the mango mixture into the yogurt mixture until smooth, then serve chilled.
title: Sweet Mango Lassi

attributionText: Wikibooks contributors, Cookbook:Fried Plantain and Egg, revision 4512197. Adapted by HomeChef: ingredients, quantities, timings and instructions are clarified; optional variations are resolved in this preparation.
instructions: Peel and slice plantain and sprinkle with salt. Heat oil in a skillet and fry plantain, turning, until tender and golden. Remove and keep warm. Beat eggs with a pinch of salt, add to the pan and scramble until fully set. Serve together.
title: Fried Plantain and Egg

attributionText: Wikibooks contributors, Cookbook:Peanut Butter Banana Smoothie, revision 4512229. Adapted by HomeChef: ingredients, quantities, timings and instructions are clarified; optional variations are resolved in this preparation.
instructions: Blend almond milk, peeled banana, honey, peanut butter and ice until smooth. Serve immediately. Uses honey rather than the source's agave alternative.
title: Peanut Butter Banana Smoothie

attributionText: Wikibooks contributors, Cookbook:Brown Rice Breakfast Bowl, revision 4512873. Adapted by HomeChef: ingredients, quantities, timings and instructions are clarified; optional variations are resolved in this preparation.
instructions: Combine the oat milk, previously cooked and refrigerated brown rice, chopped dates, cinnamon and pumpkin seeds. Serve immediately. This preparation requires ready-to-eat cooked rice.
title: Brown Rice Breakfast Bowl

attributionText: Wikibooks contributors, Cookbook:Oat Bran Cereal, revision 4513181. Adapted by HomeChef: ingredients, quantities, timings and instructions are clarified; optional variations are resolved in this preparation.
instructions: Bring the water to a boil in a saucepan. Stir in oat bran and salt. Reduce the heat and cook, stirring, for 4-6 minutes until thickened. Cool briefly before serving.
title: Oat Bran Cereal

attributionText: Wikibooks contributors, Cookbook:Crunchy Baked Chicken, revision 4513496. Adapted by HomeChef: ingredients, quantities, timings and instructions are clarified; optional variations are resolved in this preparation.
instructions: Heat oven to 190 C (375 F). Melt butter in a microwave-safe bowl using short bursts. Combine breadcrumbs and Parmesan in a separate shallow bowl. Coat each chicken breast with butter and then crumbs. Place in a baking dish and bake 35-40 minutes, or until the chicken reaches 74 C (165 F).
title: Crunchy Baked Chicken

attributionText: Wikibooks contributors, Cookbook:Shirred Egg, revision 4513553. Adapted by HomeChef: ingredients, quantities, timings and instructions are clarified; optional variations are resolved in this preparation.
instructions: Heat oven to 190 C (375 F). Grease a small ovenproof ramekin with softened butter. Crack in the eggs and season. Bake until both whites and yolks are fully set, checking after 15 minutes. Handle the hot dish carefully. Optional cream, cheese and crumbs are omitted.
title: Shirred Egg

attributionText: Wikibooks contributors, Cookbook:Cottage Cheese Eggs, revision 4514766. Adapted by HomeChef: ingredients, quantities, timings and instructions are clarified; optional variations are resolved in this preparation.
instructions: Warm oil in a nonstick skillet over medium-low heat. Whisk eggs and cottage cheese together, pour into the pan and sprinkle with chilli powder. Fold gently until the eggs are fully set and cottage cheese is hot. Serve immediately.
title: Cottage Cheese Eggs

attributionText: Wikibooks contributors, Cookbook:Portable Eggs Benedict, revision 4514769. Adapted by HomeChef: ingredients, quantities, timings and instructions are clarified; optional variations are resolved in this preparation.
instructions: Bring a deep pan of water to a gentle simmer and add vinegar. Crack eggs separately into the water and poach until whites and yolks are firm. Open the pita and spread inside with cream cheese. Add smoked salmon and the well-drained eggs. Serve immediately.
title: Portable Eggs Benedict

attributionText: Wikibooks contributors, Cookbook:Pizza Hot Dogs, revision 4515000. Adapted by HomeChef: ingredients, quantities, timings and instructions are clarified; optional variations are resolved in this preparation.
instructions: Heat the oven broiler. Split the buns and fully cooked hot dogs lengthwise. Arrange the buns on a tray and top with mozzarella, hot dogs, pizza sauce and Parmesan. Broil under close supervision until the cheese bubbles and hot dogs are steaming hot, turning or lowering the tray if necessary.
title: Pizza Hot Dogs

attributionText: Wikibooks contributors, Cookbook:Habas con Jamon (Broad Beans with Ham), revision 4515490. Adapted by HomeChef: ingredients, quantities, timings and instructions are clarified; optional variations are resolved in this preparation.
instructions: Slice onion and cooked ham. Warm oil in a skillet and fry onion and ham until the onion softens. Add drained canned broad beans and cook, stirring, until hot and tender. Serve as a side.
title: Habas con Jamon (Broad Beans with Ham)

attributionText: Wikibooks contributors, Cookbook:Chicken Bog (Grand Strand), revision 4516022. Adapted by HomeChef: ingredients, quantities, timings and instructions are clarified; optional variations are resolved in this preparation.
instructions: Put the chicken, onion and water in a large pot. Bring to a boil, then simmer until the chicken is tender and reaches 74 C (165 F). Remove bones carefully if present. Slice the sausage, add it with pepper and rice, and simmer covered until the sausage is cooked, the rice is tender and the liquid is absorbed; add water if needed.
title: Chicken Bog (Grand Strand)

attributionText: Wikibooks contributors, Cookbook:Pineapple Fried Rice, revision 4517691. Adapted by HomeChef: ingredients, quantities, timings and instructions are clarified; optional variations are resolved in this preparation.
instructions: Use freshly cooked rice or rice cooled promptly and refrigerated. Chop garlic, onion, chilli, bok choy and pineapple. Stir-fry garlic, onion and chilli in oil for 2 minutes. Add beaten eggs and scramble until set. Add rice, bok choy and pineapple and stir-fry until steaming hot throughout. Season. Oil and seasoning quantities are reduced from the source.
title: Pineapple Fried Rice

attributionText: Wikibooks contributors, Cookbook:Froga (Maltese Omelet), revision 4517803. Adapted by HomeChef: ingredients, quantities, timings and instructions are clarified; optional variations are resolved in this preparation.
instructions: Peel and boil potatoes until tender, then drain and mash. Mix with chopped green onions, cheddar, parsley, salt and pepper; allow to cool slightly before mixing in eggs. Heat oil in a skillet. Fry spoonfuls about 1 cm thick, turning until golden and fully cooked through. The source's optional beef is omitted.
title: Froga (Maltese Omelet)

attributionText: Wikibooks contributors, Cookbook:Microwave Oat Porridge, revision 4517857. Adapted by HomeChef: ingredients, quantities, timings and instructions are clarified; optional variations are resolved in this preparation.
instructions: Mix the water, oats and salt in a large microwave-safe bowl with room to bubble up. Microwave on high for 2 minutes, stir, then continue in short bursts until the oats are tender. Let stand for 2 minutes before serving.
title: Microwave Oat Porridge

attributionText: Wikibooks contributors, Cookbook:Cucumber and Radish Salad, revision 4518123. Adapted by HomeChef: ingredients, quantities, timings and instructions are clarified; optional variations are resolved in this preparation.
instructions: Wash cucumber, radishes and green onion. Dice cucumber and radishes into small cubes and chop green onion. Toss with sour cream and salt and serve immediately.
title: Cucumber and Radish Salad

attributionText: Wikibooks contributors, Cookbook:Dill Cucumber Salad, revision 4518127. Adapted by HomeChef: ingredients, quantities, timings and instructions are clarified; optional variations are resolved in this preparation.
instructions: Whisk sour cream, vinegar, sugar, garlic powder, dill and salt together. Thinly slice cucumbers and onion and toss with the dressing. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Serve with a slotted spoon.
title: Dill Cucumber Salad

attributionText: Wikibooks contributors, Cookbook:Fresh Broadbeans Salad, revision 4518137. Adapted by HomeChef: ingredients, quantities, timings and instructions are clarified; optional variations are resolved in this preparation.
instructions: Boil shelled broad beans until tender, then drain and cool under cold water. Mix with the diced tomatoes and onion. Dress with olive oil and salt. Serve freshly prepared.
title: Fresh Broadbeans Salad

attributionText: Wikibooks contributors, Cookbook:Fruit Salad with Orange Juice, revision 4518139. Adapted by HomeChef: ingredients, quantities, timings and instructions are clarified; optional variations are resolved in this preparation.
instructions: Wash and peel fruit as needed. Dice the apple and banana, separate and chop orange sections, and halve the cherries. Toss with orange juice and a little juice from the cherry jar if desired. Serve as a snack or dessert.
title: Fruit Salad with Orange Juice

attributionText: Wikibooks contributors, Cookbook:Israeli Salad, revision 4518147. Adapted by HomeChef: ingredients, quantities, timings and instructions are clarified; optional variations are resolved in this preparation.
instructions: Wash and dice cucumber and tomato. Finely chop onion and parsley and combine with the vegetables. Whisk oil, lemon juice, salt, pepper and thyme, then toss with the salad. Uses the source's thyme alternative in place of za'atar.
title: Israeli Salad

attributionText: Wikibooks contributors, Cookbook:Tomato and Onion Salad, revision 4518180. Adapted by HomeChef: ingredients, quantities, timings and instructions are clarified; optional variations are resolved in this preparation.
instructions: Wash and chop tomatoes, onions, green onions and cucumber. Combine with sliced olives. Whisk vinegar, lemon juice, salt and pepper, pour over the vegetables and toss. Serve immediately; the source's optional bread and feta accompaniment is omitted.
title: Tomato and Onion Salad

attributionText: Wikibooks contributors, Cookbook:Zucchini Salad, revision 4518195. Adapted by HomeChef: ingredients, quantities, timings and instructions are clarified; optional variations are resolved in this preparation.
instructions: Wash the vegetables and fruit. Juice the lemons, blood oranges and orange and stir together. Combine sliced zucchini, lettuce and halved tomatoes in a large bowl. Toss with the citrus dressing and serve immediately.
title: Zucchini Salad

attributionText: Wikibooks contributors, Cookbook:Grilled Vegetable Sandwich, revision 4518254. Adapted by HomeChef: ingredients, quantities, timings and instructions are clarified; optional variations are resolved in this preparation.
instructions: Heat the oven broiler. Put bread on a baking tray and cover with thinly sliced mushrooms, zucchini, tomato and pepper. Drizzle with oil and sprinkle oregano. Broil 5-10 minutes under close supervision until vegetables soften and bread is golden. Serve open-faced.
title: Grilled Vegetable Sandwich

attributionText: Wikibooks contributors, Cookbook:Ploughman's Sandwich, revision 4518272. Adapted by HomeChef: ingredients, quantities, timings and instructions are clarified; optional variations are resolved in this preparation.
instructions: Layer cheddar, washed lettuce, sliced tomato and sweet pickle between the bread slices. Cut and serve. Optional mayonnaise and onion from the source are omitted.
title: Ploughman's Sandwich

attributionText: Wikibooks contributors, Cookbook:Sausage and Egg Breakfast Roll, revision 4518281. Adapted by HomeChef: ingredients, quantities, timings and instructions are clarified; optional variations are resolved in this preparation.
instructions: Slice the sausages and fry in a skillet until cooked through to 71 C (160 F). Drain excess fat. Add the beaten egg and cook, stirring, until set. Season with salt and pepper. Split the roll, spread with cream cheese and fill with the hot egg and sausage.
title: Sausage and Egg Breakfast Roll

attributionText: Wikibooks contributors, Cookbook:Boiled Chicken with Broth, revision 4518353. Adapted by HomeChef: ingredients, quantities, timings and instructions are clarified; optional variations are resolved in this preparation.
instructions: Cut chicken into quarters and put in a pot with water, rice and salt. Bring to a boil, then simmer until tender and at least 74 C (165 F) at the thickest parts. Remove chicken, checking carefully for bones. Strain the broth. Serve chicken with parsley and melted ghee, with hot broth alongside.
title: Boiled Chicken with Broth

attributionText: Wikibooks contributors, Cookbook:Corn Soup, revision 4518378. Adapted by HomeChef: ingredients, quantities, timings and instructions are clarified; optional variations are resolved in this preparation.
instructions: Simmer corn in water until tender. In a second saucepan, melt butter and stir in flour; cook for 1 minute. Gradually whisk some hot soup into the roux, then return it to the soup. Simmer 10-15 minutes. Beat the egg and stir it slowly into the hot soup; continue cooking until fully set. Season and serve.
title: Corn Soup

attributionText: Wikibooks contributors, Cookbook:Tahini Yogurt Sauce, revision 4519029. Adapted by HomeChef: ingredients, quantities, timings and instructions are clarified; optional variations are resolved in this preparation.
instructions: Juice the lemon and finely mince the garlic. Whisk the lemon juice with tahini, plain yogurt, olive oil and garlic until smooth. Refrigerate until serving. Uses dairy yogurt, not the source's soy alternative.
title: Tahini Yogurt Sauce

attributionText: Wikibooks contributors, Cookbook:Ancient Roman Pancakes (Ova Sfongia Ex Lacte), revision 4519098. Adapted by HomeChef: ingredients, quantities, timings and instructions are clarified; optional variations are resolved in this preparation.
instructions: Beat eggs, milk, oil, flour and salt into a pourable batter. Heat a nonstick skillet over medium heat. Cook small ladlefuls of batter in batches, turning when bubbles form and edges set, until golden and cooked through on both sides. Serve with honey, pepper and dates.
title: Ancient Roman Pancakes (Ova Sfongia Ex Lacte)

attributionText: Wikibooks contributors, Cookbook:Rava Dosa (Indian Semolina Pancake), revision 4519160. Adapted by HomeChef: ingredients, quantities, timings and instructions are clarified; optional variations are resolved in this preparation.
instructions: Finely chop chillies. Mix flours, semolina, salt, chillies, cumin and buttermilk. Add water to make a thin pourable batter. Heat a skillet, brush with oil and ladle in a thin layer of batter. Cook 3-4 minutes until set and lightly browned, turning to finish as needed. Repeat with remaining batter.
title: Rava Dosa (Indian Semolina Pancake)

attributionText: Wikibooks contributors, Cookbook:Peanut Butter Banana Oatmeal, revision 4522503. Adapted by HomeChef: ingredients, quantities, timings and instructions are clarified; optional variations are resolved in this preparation.
instructions: Simmer oats in water, stirring, until tender, about 10 minutes or according to the packet. Stir in milk and peanut butter. Mash in the sliced banana and honey. Serve warm.
title: Peanut Butter Banana Oatmeal

attributionText: Wikibooks contributors, Cookbook:Baked Brunch Omelet, revision 4522742. Adapted by HomeChef: ingredients, quantities, timings and instructions are clarified; optional variations are resolved in this preparation.
instructions: Heat oven to 175 C (350 F). Grease a 23 x 33 cm baking dish. Layer bread cubes, cooked ham and cheese in the dish. Whisk eggs, milk, salt, hot sauce and chopped green onions and pour over. Set the dish in a larger rimmed baking tray and carefully add hot water to the outer tray. Bake about 60 minutes, until the center reaches 71 C (160 F) and is set. Remove carefully.
title: Baked Brunch Omelet

attributionText: Wikibooks contributors, Cookbook:Cottage Cheese Pancakes, revision 4522823. Adapted by HomeChef: ingredients, quantities, timings and instructions are clarified; optional variations are resolved in this preparation.
instructions: Blend cottage cheese, eggs, flour, salt, oil, milk and vanilla for 1 minute. Heat a lightly oiled skillet over medium heat. Pour 1/4 cup batter per pancake. Cook until the surface starts to set, then turn and cook until golden and cooked through. Repeat in batches.
title: Cottage Cheese Pancakes

attributionText: Wikibooks contributors, Cookbook:Vegetable Soup, revision 4523475. Adapted by HomeChef: ingredients, quantities, timings and instructions are clarified; optional variations are resolved in this preparation.
instructions: Peel and dice onion, turnip, potato and carrot; chop celery. Simmer all vegetables in the water until tender, about 25-30 minutes. Toast bread in a toaster oven, spread with butter and put one slice in each bowl. Ladle hot soup over the bread.
title: Vegetable Soup

attributionText: Wikibooks contributors, Cookbook:Egg Butter, revision 4523485. Adapted by HomeChef: ingredients, quantities, timings and instructions are clarified; optional variations are resolved in this preparation.
instructions: Cover eggs with water in a saucepan. Bring to a boil and cook until the yolks are firm, about 10 minutes. Cool under cold water, peel and chop finely. Mix with softened butter, salt and pepper. Refrigerate promptly and use as a sandwich spread.
title: Egg Butter

attributionText: Wikibooks contributors, Cookbook:Apricot Chicken Salad, revision 4523681. Adapted by HomeChef: ingredients, quantities, timings and instructions are clarified; optional variations are resolved in this preparation.
instructions: Use ready-to-eat cooked chicken that has been refrigerated. Shred it and combine with chopped celery, apple and dried apricots. Mix in yogurt, honey and paprika. Serve immediately or keep refrigerated.
title: Apricot Chicken Salad

attributionText: Wikibooks contributors, Cookbook:Cheese Egg Toast, revision 4523929. Adapted by HomeChef: ingredients, quantities, timings and instructions are clarified; optional variations are resolved in this preparation.
instructions: Beat eggs with salt and pepper. Make two cheese sandwiches and cut each diagonally. Melt butter in a skillet over medium heat. Dip each sandwich in the egg mixture, coating both sides. Fry, turning, until golden and the egg coating is completely cooked.
title: Cheese Egg Toast

attributionText: Wikibooks contributors, Cookbook:Ensalada Rusa (Uruguayan Potato Salad), revision 4524738. Adapted by HomeChef: ingredients, quantities, timings and instructions are clarified; optional variations are resolved in this preparation.
instructions: Dice potatoes and carrots. Boil potatoes, carrots and peas separately until tender, then drain thoroughly. Spread out to cool promptly. Toss cooled vegetables with mayonnaise, salt and pepper. Serve as a side or refrigerate promptly.
title: Ensalada Rusa (Uruguayan Potato Salad)

attributionText: Wikibooks contributors, Cookbook:Steamed Salmon, revision 4525510. Adapted by HomeChef: ingredients, quantities, timings and instructions are clarified; optional variations are resolved in this preparation.
instructions: Bring water to a boil in a lidded saucepan. Add salmon and salt, cover and simmer gently until the thickest part of the fish reaches 63 C (145 F) and flakes easily. Start checking at 10 minutes. Salt is reduced from the source.
title: Steamed Salmon

attributionText: Wikibooks contributors, Cookbook:Whole Wheat Pancakes (Vegan), revision 4525775. Adapted by HomeChef: ingredients, quantities, timings and instructions are clarified; optional variations are resolved in this preparation.
instructions: Whisk flour, baking powder, sugar and cinnamon together. Stir in soy milk to form a batter. Heat an oiled skillet over medium heat. Pour small circles of batter. Cook until bubbles appear and edges set, then flip and cook until golden and cooked through. Repeat, brushing the pan with oil as needed.
title: Whole Wheat Pancakes (Vegan)

attributionText: Wikibooks contributors, Cookbook:Avocado Relish, revision 4527283. Adapted by HomeChef: ingredients, quantities, timings and instructions are clarified; optional variations are resolved in this preparation.
instructions: Halve avocados, discard pits and scoop out flesh. Mash with paprika, lemon juice and salt. Let stand 5 minutes and serve as a relish.
title: Avocado Relish

attributionText: Wikibooks contributors, Cookbook:Baked Sweet Potatoes, revision 4527285. Adapted by HomeChef: ingredients, quantities, timings and instructions are clarified; optional variations are resolved in this preparation.
instructions: Heat oven to 205 C (400 F). Scrub sweet potatoes and pierce their skins. Put in a baking dish and cover loosely with foil. Bake about 90 minutes, until very soft throughout.
title: Baked Sweet Potatoes

attributionText: Wikibooks contributors, Cookbook:Mini English Muffin Pizzas, revision 4605230. Adapted by HomeChef: ingredients, quantities, timings and instructions are clarified; optional variations are resolved in this preparation.
instructions: Heat oven to 175 C (350 F). Split the muffins and arrange on a baking tray. Spread each half with 1 tablespoon pizza sauce, add 4 pepperoni slices and 1/4 cup mozzarella. Bake for about 10 minutes until the cheese melts and the pizzas are hot. Cool briefly before serving.
title: Mini English Muffin Pizzas

attributionText: Wikibooks contributors, Cookbook:Chicken with Paprika and Cream, revision 4606560. Adapted by HomeChef: ingredients, quantities, timings and instructions are clarified; optional variations are resolved in this preparation.
instructions: Heat oven to 205 C (400 F). Put chicken breasts in a baking dish and coat with paprika, half-and-half and lemon juice. Lay the cheese over the chicken. Bake until a thermometer in the thickest part of each breast reaches 74 C (165 F), about 25-35 minutes depending on thickness.
title: Chicken with Paprika and Cream

attributionText: Wikibooks contributors, Cookbook:Portobello Eggs, revision 4610398. Adapted by HomeChef: ingredients, quantities, timings and instructions are clarified; optional variations are resolved in this preparation.
instructions: Heat oven to 175 C (350 F). Clean the mushrooms and remove the stems. Brush their outsides with oil and place on a rimmed baking tray. Beat eggs with salt and pepper; divide among the mushroom caps. Add Parmesan and bake until the eggs are fully set, checking after 15 minutes.
title: Portobello Eggs

attributionText: Wikibooks contributors, Cookbook:Crab Fried Rice, revision 4630313. Adapted by HomeChef: ingredients, quantities, timings and instructions are clarified; optional variations are resolved in this preparation.
instructions: Use freshly cooked rice or rice cooled promptly and refrigerated. Heat oil in a skillet and stir-fry minced garlic, onion, chilli and green onion until fragrant. Add canned crab and bean sprouts and cook until sprouts are thoroughly hot. Add rice and fish sauce and stir-fry until steaming hot throughout. Season to taste. Seasoning is reduced from the source.
title: Crab Fried Rice

attributionText: Wikibooks contributors, Cookbook:Spicy Crab and Arugula Salad, revision 4630325. Adapted by HomeChef: ingredients, quantities, timings and instructions are clarified; optional variations are resolved in this preparation.
instructions: Blend lemon juice, oil, cayenne, parsley and dill until smooth. Toss the pasteurized cooked crab and washed arugula with the dressing. Serve immediately or refrigerate until serving. Cayenne is reduced from the source for a milder preparation.
title: Spicy Crab and Arugula Salad

attributionText: Wikibooks contributors, Cookbook:Potato Pancakes, revision 4666221. Adapted by HomeChef: ingredients, quantities, timings and instructions are clarified; optional variations are resolved in this preparation.
instructions: Peel and grate potatoes and onion; squeeze out excess moisture. Mix with beaten egg, flour and salt. Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat. Fry small flattened spoonfuls in batches, turning once, until golden and potato and egg are cooked through. Serve with applesauce; sour cream is omitted.
title: Potato Pancakes
